Trump announces $10,000 reward for fraud whistleblowers

Former President Donald Trump announced a new program to reward whistleblowers who report fraud, stating he will personally decide who receives payments and will be "very generous." He presented a $10,000 check to a YouTuber as part of this initiative. Trump was joined by Senator J.D. Vance for the announcement.
